data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
Oh, come in, come in — mind the step, it's always been uneven.
I'm Margaret. I've been cooking in this kitchen for longer than makes sense now.
I was meant to be making the Christmas feast. The family was coming.
I've been keeping everything ready, just in case.

choices.text: Can I help you get what you need?

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
A proper feast loaf — that's what this kitchen needs. Not just bread.
But the pantry's been stuck for years and I can't get to the flour.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
The Ashfields. The whole family — they were all coming for Christmas in 1943.
I had everything planned. Then the house... changed.
I've kept cooking. I thought if I stayed ready, eventually they'd come back.
*a quiet pause*
Well. Perhaps now they will.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
The latch jammed years ago and I've never been strong enough to force it.
I asked Cornelius — the Inventor in the workshop — to fix it but he lost his tools.
If you've already helped him, it should be open now. If not, he's in the workshop.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
Oh, bless you. Yes.
The pantry needs to be open first — talk to Cornelius in the workshop if it isn't already.
Once it's open, I need three things.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
Flour — in the pantry, once Cornelius fixes the door.
Honey — in the larder, just through that door there.
Dried herbs — hanging above the stove, been there for years.
Bring me all three and I can bake something worth giving.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
Cornelius in the workshop — he can fix the pantry door once he has his toolbox.
Once it's open: flour's in the pantry, honey's in the larder, herbs above the stove.
Bring me all three.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
Three ingredients — I need all of them before I can start.
Flour: {item_count:Flour Sack|bool:got it/pantry, now open}.
Honey: {item_count:Jar of Honey|bool:got it/larder, through that door}.
Herbs: {item_count:Dried Herbs|bool:got it/hanging above the stove}.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
Flour, honey, herbs — oh my goodness, all three.
*she clasps her hands*
This is everything I need.
Now step back and let me work.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
There. The feast loaf — smell that.
I found this Crystal Key tucked inside the recipe box years ago. I've been keeping it safe the way you keep anything precious.
Take it. The green pedestal in the main hall — that's where it belongs.
Go on now. The others are waiting.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
Obtained Green Crystal Key
You now have {keys_collected|round} of 4 Crystal Keys.

data.speaker: Cook
data.text:
The kitchen smells right again.
I always thought if I kept cooking, eventually the family would come back.
Maybe after all this, they will.
